blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala faces Chinese qualifier Shi Han to begin her campaign in the Wuhan Open round of 64 in China. The match is scheduled Monday night, tentatively set at 8:40 p.m. at Dongfeng-Voyah Center Court. Eala is seeded 13th in the WTA 1000 hardcourt tournament, which marks her return on tour after an early exit at the Singapore Open late last month.
